entries.summary: Held in the dungeon of White Plume Mountain, Wave is engraved with images of waves, shells, and sea creatures. Mastery: Topple.

entries.label: Whelm
entries.summary: Whelm is a powerful weapon forged by dwarves and lost in the dungeon of White Plume Mountain. Mastery: Push.

entries.label: Whip
entries.summary: Whip Mastery: Slow.

entries.label: Will of the Talon (Dormant)
entries.summary: Black, blue, green, red, and white gems carved in the form of dragon heads cover this ostentatious gold war pick, marking it as a weapon channeling the power of Tiamat. Mastery: Sap.
